[Your name]

Dear Ms Norr,

I am writing regarding the rent charged for 1 to 8 June.

As you know, I moved all of my belongings out of the flat on 31 May and did not live there at any point in June. I returned the keys on 8 June, which was the earliest I was able to get to your office.

If you are able to agree, please send the refund to my usual account, the one from which my rent payments were made. If you need any further information from me, I am happy to provide it.

Thank you for your consideration, and for your help throughout my tenancy.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
[Your address and contact details]

Warm regards,
[Your name]

I moved all of my belongings out and left the flat on 31 May, and it stood empty from that date. I was not living there at any point in June. I returned all keys on 8 June, which was the earliest day I was able to get to your office.

Thank you for your time and for your consideration of this request. Please let me know if you need any further details from me.

Kind regards,

Dear Orla,

I hope you're well. Ahead of my move-out on 30 June, I wanted to ask whether you'd be happy for me to repaint the living room over my last weekend here, 28–29 June. I'd use the original pale grey so it matches what was there when I moved in, and I'd take care to leave everything tidy afterwards.

[Your name]

Dear Ms Norr,

I hope this letter finds you well. I am writing regarding the rent you charged me for the period of 1 to 8 June.

As you know, I removed all of my belongings from the flat on 31 May, and from that date onward I was no longer living there. While I returned the keys at your office on 8 June — the earliest opportunity I had to do so — the flat was empty and unoccupied for the entire month of June.

Thank you very much for your understanding and for your cooperation throughout my tenancy. Please let me know if you need any further information.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
[Your address]
[Date]

I’m writing to ask whether you would consider refunding the rent charged for 1–8 June.

I moved out and removed all my belongings on 31 May, so I was not living in the flat during June. I returned all keys on 8 June, when I was able to get to your office.

I understand that our signed agreement says rent continues through the day all keys are returned, and that you charged me only through that date. Nevertheless, given that I had vacated the flat by the end of May, I would appreciate your considering a goodwill refund of the June rent.

If you agree, please send the refund to my usual account.

Thank you for considering my request.

Kind regards,
[Your name]
Note: Under the agreement you described, the 1–8 June charge appears consistent with its terms, so this letter requests a goodwill refund rather than claiming an entitlement.
